verdict.rationale: Claude Code's own docs say that through MCP it can read design docs in Google Drive, update Jira tickets, and pull data from Slack. They also document connecting to hundreds of external tools with commands like `claude mcp add`, and give concrete Jira and Slack workflow prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations, and documented setup steps specific to Jira, Slack or Google Drive (the only command example shown is Notion).

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the agent to workflow tools like Jira, Slack, and Google Drive to extend its context

citations.quote: With MCP, Claude Code can read your design docs in Google Drive, update tickets in Jira, pull data from Slack, or use your own custom tooling.
Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com/mcp
Implement features from issue trackers: "Add the feature described in JIRA issue ENG-4521 and create a PR on GitHub."
